source.author: Robert Jamieson, A. R. Fausset and David Brown
source.edition: CCEL expanded electronic edition of the 1871 public-domain text

entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 145:1-21 . A Psalm of praise to God for His mighty, righteous, and gracious government of all men, and of His humble and suffering people in particular.
3. (Compare Ps 18:3; 48:1 ). greatness --as displayed in His works.

entries.heading: 4. shall declare
entries.text: 4. shall declare --literally, "they shall declare," that is, all generations.

entries.heading: 5. I will speak
entries.text: 5. I will speak --or, "muse" ( Ps 77:12; 119:15 ). thy wondrous works --or, "words of thy wonders," that is, which described them ( Ps 105:27 , Margin ).

entries.heading: 6. terrible acts
entries.text: 6. terrible acts --which produce dread or fear.

entries.heading: 7. memory
entries.text: 7. memory -- ( Ps 6:5 ), remembrance, or what causes to be remembered. righteousness --as in Ps 143:1 , goodness according to covenant engagement.
8, 9. (Compare Ps 103:8; 111:4 ). over all, &c.--rests on all His works.

entries.heading: 10. bless
entries.text: 10. bless --as in Ps 145:1 , to praise with reverence, more than merely to praise.
11, 12. The declaration of God's glory is for the extension of His knowledge and perfections in the world.

entries.heading: 15, 16. eyes of . . . thee
entries.text: 15, 16. eyes of . . . thee --or, look with expecting faith ( Ps 104:27, 28 ).

entries.heading: 17. holy . . . works
entries.text: 17. holy . . . works --literally, "merciful" or "kind, goodness" ( Ps 144:2 ) is the corresponding noun. righteous --in a similar relation of meaning to "righteousness" ( Ps 145:7 ).
20. Those who fear Him ( Ps 145:19 ) are those who are here said to love Him.
21. (Compare Ps 33:21 ). all flesh -- ( Ps 65:2 ). The Psalm ends, as it began, with ascriptions of praise, in which the pious will ever delight to join.
